related.title: SQL 視窗函數：排名、同分與 ROWS 框架
related.titleEn: SQL windows: ranking,ties and ROWS frames
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：列出從 A 可到達的所有工程相依，並讓循環輸入仍然終止。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Enumerate all engineering dependencies reachable from A while ensuring cyclic input terminates. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 對同分成績比較 ROW_NUMBER、RANK、DENSE_RANK，並核對累積總分。
related.differenceEn: Compare ROW_NUMBER,RANK,DENSE_RANK on ties and reconcile running totals.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 遞迴 CTE 由種子與遞迴項組成；節點去重和路徑去重不是同一問題。 教學基準：2+1+1 = 4 reachable nodes excluding A；第二檢核：2+2+2 = 6 walk rows at depths 1 to 3。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
排序同分的名次語意不同；ROWS 框架用實際列位置，須用唯一鍵建立可重現順序。 教學基準：90+90+80+70 = 330 total points；第二檢核：90+90+80 = 260 third-row running points。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Recursive CTEs combine an anchor and recursive term; deduplicating nodes differs from deduplicating paths. Teaching baseline: 2+1+1 = 4 reachable nodes excluding A; second check: 2+2+2 = 6 walk rows at depths 1 to 3. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

Ranking functions handle peers differently; a ROWS frame uses physical row positions and needs a unique tie breaker. Teaching baseline: 90+90+80+70 = 330 total points; second check: 90+90+80 = 260 third-row running points. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: SQLite WAL：讀者快照與 checkpoint 界線
related.titleEn: SQLite WAL: reader snapshots and checkpoint boundaries
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：列出從 A 可到達的所有工程相依，並讓循環輸入仍然終止。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Enumerate all engineering dependencies reachable from A while ensuring cyclic input terminates. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 以兩連線觀察 WAL 模式的讀者與寫者並行，確認 checkpoint 不能破壞舊讀者。
related.differenceEn: Observe readers and writers with two WAL connections and verify checkpoints preserve old snapshots.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 遞迴 CTE 由種子與遞迴項組成；節點去重和路徑去重不是同一問題。 教學基準：2+1+1 = 4 reachable nodes excluding A；第二檢核：2+2+2 = 6 walk rows at depths 1 to 3。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
WAL 追加已變更頁，讀者記住 end mark；checkpoint 受仍在使用舊 WAL 範圍的讀者限制。 教學基準：32+12*(4096+24) = 49472 modeled WAL bytes；第二檢核：12*4096 = 49152 page payload bytes。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Recursive CTEs combine an anchor and recursive term; deduplicating nodes differs from deduplicating paths. Teaching baseline: 2+1+1 = 4 reachable nodes excluding A; second check: 2+2+2 = 6 walk rows at depths 1 to 3. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

WAL appends changed pages and readers retain end marks; checkpoints are constrained by readers using older WAL ranges. Teaching baseline: 32+12*(4096+24) = 49472 modeled WAL bytes; second check: 12*4096 = 49152 page payload bytes. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
